title: After a batch merges, each handed-in lane PR that conflicts with the new main gets one main merge and a review of the resolved hunks only
why: Coordinator 14:59 CST Nov 12: batch 104 (#2814) left #2733, #2737, #2770, #2875, #2920 and #2748, #2833, #2913 in conflict with main; each needed the same pick (merge main in, fresh review of the resolved hunks as a fix check).
note: Write the route in skill ci-hygiene step 8 (Batch lanes): at a batch merge, the runner lists handed-in PRs that now conflict with main; each lane merges main once (no rebase, no force push) and a fresh reviewer reads only the resolved hunks, recorded as a fix check chained to the prior record; a refused chain means a full review. Then the per-PR coordinator pick is not needed. Relates to lane-lint-batch-pr-conflicts and record-before-fix-push. Lane started 15:02 CST Nov 12 (coordinator; no open PR names the step; kin #2326 cited).
